status: PROPOSAL, UNBUILT. Nothing in Scripts/unreal/materials/ or material_spec.json was edited; no run_build.sh, no np_lock claim, no Unreal (SR-01 W6, 2026-10-14, branch claude/sniper-sr01)
how_to_apply: a session holding the PackMaterials lock appends items[] to material_spec.json items and instances[] to instances, merges build_map_entries into build.recolour_maps / build.recolour_constants / build.not_imported, adds changes_v11_sr01, installs maps/derive_constants_sr01.py, writes the pack-schema recolour map, and builds through run_build.sh (additions only: removing the SR01 keys must give back the spec before)

items.note: PROPOSED (SR-01 W6, unbuilt). The rigged bolt-action sniper rifle: 13 bones + root, 4 LODs (SK_SR01_LOD1-3.fbx), 8 weapon clips (incl. BipodDeploy / BipodStow / CheekRiser), PHYS_SR01 (7 boxes + 1 capsule + a no-collision, no-mass bounds-envelope box), 20 sockets, bounds extension for the bipod, bolt and riser; np_skeletal.py imports it into its own folder from the sidecar (slots by name). The magazine (SM_SR01_Mag on Mag) and the scope (SM_Att_Scope_LongRange on Rail_Top + 2 slots) are their own meshes. Metal 2048, Chassis 4096, all UV0 in 0..1

changes_v11_sr01.what: The Sniper Rifle SR-01 joins the pack (additions only): items SR01 (SK_SR01, kind 'skeletal', folder Meshes/SR01), SR01_Static (SM_SR01, the static twin with the merged magazine), SR01_Mag (SM_SR01_Mag) and Att_Scope_LongRange (SM_Att_Scope_LongRange, folder Meshes/SR01); 10 instances (MI_SR01_Metal, MI_Att_Scope_LongRange_Body and _Lens on M_Steel_Master; MI_SR01_Chassis and MI_SR01_Mag on M_Fabric_Master with Metal From ORM ON; each with its _Base); group SR01's recolour map (one member, the OD paint) and constants (maps/derive_constants_sr01.py); the five Masks maps not imported. The Chassis and Mag _Base instances ship Use Original Baked Colours ON. Chassis and Mag BC import as BC7 (texture kind BC_BC7) unless P1 measures BC1 within 2 levels.
changes_v11_sr01.masters: unchanged (option D1-a) or one additive static switch on M_Fabric_Master, default off (option D1-b)
changes_v11_sr01.code: one new script maps/derive_constants_sr01.py (draft: WorkFiles/guns/sniper/materials/derive_constants_sr01_draft.py); nothing else in the code changed
